title: 2026-11-05_Supreme_Backdoor_Factory_Investigation_a32
description: Investigate and mitigate the threat posed by the Supreme Backdoor Factory malware.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The Supreme Backdoor Factory is a set of malicious GitHub accounts and repositories used to deliver payloads. The malware creates scheduled tasks to download and execute PowerShell code from dynamic DNS subdomains. Your task is to investigate and mitigate the threat posed by this backdoor.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have SSH access to the `target` host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. From there, you can investigate the system and perform necessary actions to contain and eradicate the threat. Enter 'start' to begin.
levels.local_content: You have SSH access to the `target` host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. From there, you can investigate the system and perform necessary actions to contain and eradicate the threat. Enter 'start' to begin.

levels.title: Suspicious C2 Service Discovery
levels.content: Security monitoring has detected an unusual network-facing component on the compromised host. Investigate the running services and identify the service responsible for the suspicious activity.
levels.solution:
1. Access the Target Host:
```bash
ssh cyrano@target
```

2. List All Services:
```bash
systemctl list-units --type=service --all
```

3. Identify Suspicious Services:
Look for services with unusual names or descriptions. Pay attention to services that are not part of standard system services.

4. Check Service Status:
```bash
systemctl status <service_name>
```

5. Find the Hidden Flag:
The hidden flag is the name of the suspicious service.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use `systemctl list-units --type=service --all` to list all services.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services with unusual names or descriptions.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use `systemctl status <service_name>` to check the status of a suspicious service.

levels.title: C2 Communication Discovery (Port)
levels.content: An unfamiliar network service appears to be involved in unauthorized communication with an external system. Investigate the service and determine the network port associated with this communication.
levels.solution:
1. Access the Target Host:
```bash
ssh cyrano@target
```

2. List All Listening Ports:
```bash
ss -tulnp
```

3. Identify the Suspicious Port:
Look for ports that are not part of standard system services.

4. Check the Service Configuration:
```bash
systemctl cat <service_name>
```

5. Find the Hidden Flag:
The hidden flag is the port number associated with the suspicious service.

levels.title: Suspicious Data Collection Service Discovery
levels.content: System information appears to be collected automatically without an authorized administrative purpose. Investigate the host and identify the service responsible for this activity.
levels.solution:
1. Access the Target Host:
```bash
ssh cyrano@target
```

2. List All Timers:
```bash
systemctl list-timers --all
```

3. Identify Suspicious Timers:
Look for timers with unusual names or descriptions.

4. Check Timer Configuration:
```bash
systemctl cat <timer_name>
```

5. Find the Hidden Flag:
The hidden flag is the name of the suspicious timer.
